definitions.explanation: Western countries collectively, including Europe and North America.

examples.japanese: {欧米|おうべい}では{習慣|しゅうかん}が{違|ちが}う。
examples.english: Customs are different in the West.

examples.japanese: {欧米|おうべい}{諸国|しょこく}との{貿易|ぼうえき}が{盛|さか}んだ。
examples.english: Trade with Western countries is thriving.

examples.japanese: この{製品|せいひん}は{欧米|おうべい}で{人気|にんき}がある。
examples.english: This product is popular in Europe and America.

notes:
USAGE: {欧米|おうべい} is a common abbreviation combining {欧州|おうしゅう} (Europe) and {米国|べいこく} (America).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{欧米|おうべい}{諸国|しょこく} (Western countries)
・{欧米|おうべい}{文化|ぶんか} (Western culture)
・{欧米|おうべい}{人|じん} (Westerners)
・{欧米|おうべい}{風|ふう} (Western-style)

COMPONENTS:
・{欧|おう} = Europe ({欧州|おうしゅう})
・{米|べい} = America ({米国|べいこく})

RELATED:
・{西洋|せいよう} - the West (broader term)
・{東洋|とうよう} - the East (contrast)
